import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df[df['sex'].notna()]
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    valid_body_mass = (df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)
    df = df[valid_body_mass]
    df = df[df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
